answer: Artifact-filing bond: one relic per identity in a crystal registry, 70 credits locked. A plume-stamped provenance binds relic, key and epoch; its crystal seal exposes reuse. Auditors spot-check provenance; a duplicate relic or reused plume stamp burns it. First filing 38, k-th 38+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,034,000 + 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented-relic rings fail: no ring holds 1,000. Honest agents pay 38 once and get the bond back.
